title: Wire Four Corner Dock Into Framework Os Shell
description: Wire the new four-corner composable dock API (from ui/js/react/index.tsx and framework/core/js/index.ts) into framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx, the last remaining consumer of the old two-panel (leftPanelTabs/rightPanelTabs, SidePanel, floating Footer toolbar) API. Replace the layout reducer slice, default dock assembly, drag-and-drop wiring, persistence via DockLayoutStore, reset action, hotkeys, and the Layout call site. Update framework/renderer/react/index.test.ts accordingly. Do not touch ui/js/react/index.tsx or framework/core/js/index.ts. Verify via typecheck and test nx targets for @semio-tech/framework-renderer-react.
summary:
Wired the new four-corner composable dock API (ui/js/react's PanelCorner/PanelDock/CornerPanel/PanelDockProvider/singleTreeLeaf/DockLayoutStore etc.) into framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx, the last consumer still on the old two-panel (leftPanelTabs/rightPanelTabs, SidePanel, floating Footer toolbar) API.

Changes in os-shell.tsx:
- Reducer: replaced leftPanelVisible/rightPanelVisible/leftPanelSize/rightPanelSize/leftPanelPath/rightPanelPath with cornerPanels: Record<PanelCorner, {visible,size,path}> + dockOverride: DockSkeleton|null; replaced the six old SET_LEFT/RIGHT_PANEL_* actions with SET_CORNER_PANEL_VISIBLE/SIZE/PATH {corner,value}, SET_DOCK_OVERRIDE, and RESET_DOCK (clears dockOverride and every corner's path, keeps visible/size as user prefs).
- panelSideForGroup -> panelCornerForGroup (workbench/document->top-left, details->top-right, display->bottom-left, settings->bottom-right, else->top-right).
- All 6 `{ kind: "leaf", ..., tree: X }` call sites converted to `singleTreeLeaf({...})`.
- New defaultDock useMemo assembling all four corners; new frameworkToolsActionsTab/frameworkToolsHistoryTab leaves (bottom-right, split from the old combined footer ToolTree) and frameworkSyncTab leaf (bottom-left, relocated SyncAttachCard) replacing the old floating footer toolbar.
- dock = applyDockSkeleton(defaultDock, dockOverride); DockLayoutStore instantiated via new DockLayoutStore(createBrowserStoragePort(), session?.app.id); seeded from getSnapshot() on mount/app-switch, persisted via save()/dockSkeletonsEqual (guarded by a one-shot ref so the very first commit never clobbers a persisted skeleton before it's read).
- Drag-and-drop: PanelDockProvider wraps the Layout call; handleTabDockDrop/handleTreeUnitDockDrop compute moveTabInDock/moveTreeUnitInDock, update dockOverride, reconcile active paths, and unfold the drop target corner.
- cornerActivePaths generalizes the old leftPanelActivePath/rightPanelActivePath studio/plugin "snap to active panel tab" overrides across all four corners via findPanelTabInDock.
- Layout call site: cornerPanels={{...}} (only non-empty corners), footer={<Footer items={[]} />}.
- useSidePanelChromeHotkeys -> useCornerPanelChromeHotkeys.
- SettingsHostApi gained onResetDock?: () => void; buildSettingsGeneralTree's general section gained a reset-dock Button (icon="rotate-ccw") wired to RESET_DOCK + dockLayoutStore.reset().
- Removed now-dead FOOTER_TOOL_CATEGORIES const and an already-unused findPanelTabNode import.

Changes in index.test.ts: updated the "toggles the layout slice" reducer test to the corner-based action shape, and added a RESET_DOCK reducer test.

Verification: no typecheck target existed for this nx project, so I typechecked via a scratch tsconfig (kept in this ticket folder) mirroring ui/js/react's tsconfig (target/module/jsx/strict + allowImportingTsExtensions). Confirmed via manual source inspection that every remaining os-shell.tsx/index.test.ts error is either in code I never touched (WindowLayoutNode/EngagementControl/EngagementOption/ToolLeaf/IconSource/Button-missing-icon/Select-missing-id patterns spread across the whole file, and unrelated AppDefinition/ToolNode test fixtures) or is a pre-existing type-shape bug I relocated verbatim (SyncAttachCard's syncTools cast, and the Button "size" prop typing gap that affects every Button call in this file including my new one). bunx nx run @semio-tech/framework-renderer-react:test: 106 passed, 1 failed — the failure ("builds spawned engagement and measures chrome from plugin contributions") is a pre-existing fixture bug (windowKind fixture missing an `options` field) in code I never touched, unrelated to the dock work; I did not find any "Shell*Panel/Dialog" tests in this file (that description may refer to ui/js/react's own suite). bunx nx run @semio-tech/framework-renderer-react:lint: 1 pre-existing unrelated violation in components/world-terrain-layer.tsx.

Files touched: framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx, framework/renderer/react/index.test.ts. Scratch verification tsconfig left in this ticket folder. Did not touch ui/js/react/index.tsx, framework/core/js/index.ts, or the storybook stories (optional, skipped for time).
